_note: Voice script for GRID CLASH. Every character is voiced by Qwen3-TTS Base voice cloning of a reference clip in refs/ that is itself a Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign take (a designed voice, no real person). 'voice' + 'clone.style' document the VoiceDesign prompt that made the reference; 'concept' is the target derived from the character art (public/chars/*-lv*.jpg); 'gender': 'female' / 'male' makes post_voice.py gate takes on a gender classifier (QA only). 'asr' (optional) is the reference text for the character-error-rate check when the spoken text has non-lexical sounds. 'say' (optional) is what the TTS speaks when it differs from the caption 'text' (exclamation marks make Qwen shout male voices an octave up); 'f0_target' (optional) is the pitch post_voice.py prefers when choosing takes.

sad.concept: Young-adult paladin in gold armour and winged helm, stoic and focused: a warm, clear, confident baritone, heroic but natural, never shouted or shrill.
sad.voice: A brave adult man in his thirties, a holy paladin knight. Warm, natural and confident baritone with a heroic, noble tone, relaxed full chest voice, clear pronunciation. Strong but never shouting and never shrill.

marki.concept: A massive armoured bull with lava-cracked hide, snorting steam: a thick, deep, guttural bass with a growl underneath, still intelligible.
marki.voice: A gigantic minotaur warrior, a male beast with a massive chest. Extremely deep, low-pitched bass voice, rough, raspy and gravelly. He never yells in a high voice: even when furious he growls and roars from deep in the chest, low register throughout, heavy and intimidating.

walk.concept: A scrappy shield fighter in leather and chainmail (rune armour at lv3), shouting as he charges: a brave man like sad but rougher, darker and lower, steady and terse.
walk.voice: A grizzled veteran soldier in his fifties, a shield guardian. Rough, gravelly, husky low baritone, weathered but unshakable, calm and steady, short clipped decisive words, quiet authority, never shouting.

insaner.concept: A small purple imp with horns, tail and a manic fanged grin: a sly, wicked creature voice (not a child) under real demonic modulation.
insaner.voice: A small evil demon imp, a wicked little goblin creature. Raspy, nasal, scratchy and sly voice with a hissing edge, sneaky and malicious, with a nasty snicker. Sounds like a wicked creature, not like a child or a baby: mid pitch with a gritty, crackly texture.

brutile.concept: A green-skinned, fanged, sneering witch in a horned crown hat: an unmistakably female, aged, raspy, cackling villainess voice with energy.
brutile.voice: A wicked old witch, an elderly woman in her seventies. Old female voice: thin, dry, crackly and raspy with age, slightly shaky, sneering and mocking, with a wicked cackle. Speaks slowly and theatrically, savoring each word. Clearly an old grandmother's voice, not a young woman and not a man.

michelle.concept: A gloomy little girl whose long bangs hide her eyes, always holding a doll; she lays doll traps behind her. A quiet, soft, slightly breathy child's voice with a flat, eerie calm: unsettling, never cute, babyish or shrill.
michelle.voice: A gloomy, quiet little girl of about ten who always holds an old doll. Soft, hushed, slightly breathy voice in a natural low-middle child pitch, speaking slowly with a flat, eerie calm, as if telling a secret. Melancholic and unsettling. Never cute, never babyish, never squeaky, never shrill, never excited.

picker.concept: A lone frontier cowboy of about 30 with a lasso who hops diagonally through every square: a laconic, low, dry drawl, calm and confident, a little amused, never shouted.
picker.voice: A lone frontier cowboy in his thirties, a man of few words. Low, dry, slightly husky baritone with a relaxed, unhurried drawl. Calm, confident and a little amused, speaking softly and slowly from the chest. Never shouting, never excited.

clone.style: Laconic, calm and dry, low and slow.

rakaeli.concept: A beautiful, pale blindfolded fallen angel in his late teens (black silk blindfold, cracked dim halo, ash-grey wings) who transforms (타천) into a demon with crimson eyes, horns and flame wings. Base form: a soft, calm, melancholic young male voice with a pretty-boy timbre, elegant, quiet and sorrowful. Transformed form: the same young man, deeper and colder, speaking with a doubled, demonic voice.
rakaeli.voice: A delicate, pretty young man of about seventeen, a fallen angel. A youthful, light tenor voice in a medium-high pitch, soft and silky, gentle and refined, with a quiet sadness. He speaks calmly and slowly with clear pronunciation. Never low or gravelly, never shouting, never a child.

clone.style: Soft, calm and melancholic, quiet and elegant.
clone._from: VoiceDesign take (seed 11, take 4) of 32 over three prompts; trimmed, a 1.6 s pause with a breath cut to 0.4 s. F0 160 Hz (130-211 Hz), warble 0.024, HNR 17.9 dB, harshness -21.9 dB (soft), CER 0, P(female) 0.001 / 0.015. A first prompt ("soft ... young male voice ... never deep") gave only 77-125 Hz takes, deeper than the cowboy, and was rejected; the second prompt ("eighteen-year-old ... light, soft young tenor") reached 155 Hz on one take of 16, with a creakier 0.05 warble.

rakaeli._note: Lines with "fx": "rakaeli-awake" are the transformed form (타천): the same cloned takes, processed by post_voice.fx_rakaeli_awake (2 semitones down, formants -6 %, a detuned WORLD double, a quiet octave-down shadow, saturation, a dark tail). awake-end is spoken as he turns back, so it keeps the base chain. 48 kbps AAC: he has about twice the lines of other characters.

lines.style: Soft, calm and melancholic, quiet and elegant.
